limits: No checkpoint/model/dataset/raw-particle-prediction/test file was loaded. Checkpoint metadata are not checkpoint-byte verification.
This is repeated fixed validation under the frozen training protocol, not full-rollout or independent-test evidence; final checkpoints remain selected at100k irrespective of validation outcomes.
Each record averages particles within frame, frames equally within trajectory, and30trajectories equally. Three-seed sample SD is descriptive and not a confidence interval.
Paired percent differences are calculated per seed before averaging; percentages of group means are separately labeled. NLL uses absolute differences only.
All saved-bin arithmetic is checked, but particle-level bin assignments cannot be independently recovered from these records.
All six configs differ only by objective/seed, with identical saved data identity fields; raw data hashes and same training minibatch/noise outcomes were not independently replayed.
Paired initialization metrics have small recorded differences. Matched seed/configuration does not establish bitwise-identical numerical predictions; this audit does not assign their cause.
Previous timestamp/status objects remain recorded as originally observed; this audit does not revise them to final status.
Wall/counter bookkeeping is in the separate timing_audit.json. Unexplained1429/1533 discrepancies are not attributed to a cause.
No frozen source, protocol, public scientific artifact, manuscript, process state or prior verification file was changed.
